comment: ACP sessions request Copilot's raw session-event feed and record sub-agent attribution (subagent_started/completed/failed lifecycle events, agent_id/parent_tool_call_id on sub-agent tool calls, retroactive subagent_message/subagent_thought markers); the session events endpoint gains before=/limit= backward JSON paging, continuity-qualified and atomic with event-log rebuilds (HTTP protocol 23).
